= 't', long)]\n81\t        timeout: Option<u64>,\n82\t\n83\t        /// Resume an existing worker session (used by hot-reload).\n84\t        #[arg(long)]\n85\t        resume: bool,\n86\t\n87\t        /// Enable or disable hot-reload for this worker.\n88\t        #[arg(long)]\n89\t        hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n90\t    },\n91\t\n92\t    /// Stop running worker(s).\n93\t    Stop {\n94\t        /// Stop all needle workers.\n95\t        #[arg(long)]\n96\t        all: bool,\n97\t\n98\t        /// Identifier of the worker to stop.\n99\t        #[arg(short = 'i', long)]\n100\t        identifier: format: ListFormat,\n119\t    },\n120\t\n121\t    /// Attach to a worker's tmux session.\n122\t    Attach {\n123\t        /// Worker identifier (e.g., alpha, bravo) or partial session name.\n124\t        identifier: String,\n125\t    },\n126\t\n127\t    /// Show fleet status, bead counts, and cost summary.\n128\t    Status {\n129\t        /// Output format.\n130\t        #[arg(long, value_enum, #[arg(long)]\n147\t        until: Option<String>,\n148\t\n149\t        /// Show cooldown state for idle-time strands (reflect, weave, pulse, unravel).\n150\t        #[arg(long)]\n151\t        idle_strands: bool,\n152\t    },\n153\t\n154\t    /// View and query telemetry logs.\n155\t    Logs {\n156\t        /// Stream events in real-time (tail -f equivalent).\n157\t        #[arg(long)]\n158\t        follow: bool,\n159\t\n160\t        /// Filter expression(s). the new rules.\n263\t    #[command(name = \"update-rules\")]\n264\t    UpdateRules {\n265\t        /// Destination path for the downloaded config (default: config/gitleaks.toml).\n266\t        #[arg(short = 'o', long)]\n267\t        output: Option<PathBuf>,\n268\t    },\n269\t\n270\t    /// Show outcome statistics aggregated from telemetry logs.\n271\t    ///\n272\t    /// Reads JSONL #[arg(long)]\n286\t        since: Option<String>,\n287\t\n288\t        /// Include only events until this time (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d, 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z).\n289\t        #[arg(long)]\n290\t        until: Option<String>,\n291\t\n292\t        /// Output format.\n293\t        #[arg(long, value_enum, default_value = \"table\")]\n294\t        format: ListFormat,\n295\t    },\n296\t}\n297\t\n298\t/// Output format for the list command.\n299\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]\n300\tpub enum ListFormat {\n301\t    Table,\n302\t    Json,\n303\t}\n304\t\n305\t/// Output format for the logs `needle stats` command.\n319\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]\n320\tpub enum StatsBy {\n321\t    /// Group by template version tag (e.g., `\"pluck-v2\"`).\n322\t    #[value(name = \"template_version\")]\n323\t    TemplateVersion,\n324\t    /// Group by template name / task type (e.g., `\"pluck\"`).\n325\t    #[value(name = \"task_type\")]\n326\t    TaskType,\n327\t    /// Group ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n333\t// Entry point\n334\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n335\t\n336\t/// Entry point called from `main`.\n337\tpub fn run() -> Result<()> {\n338\t    let cli = Cli::parse();\n339\t\n340\t    match cli.command {\n341\t        CliCommand::Run {\n342\t            workspace,\n343\t            agent,\n344\t            count,\n345\t            identifier,\n346\t            timeout,\n347\t            resume,\n348\t            hot_reload,\n349\t        } => cmd_run(\n350\t            workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, resume, hot_reload,\n351\t        ),\n352\t        CliCommand::Stop { all, identifier } => cmd_stop(all, identifier),\n353\t        CliCommand::Cleanup { all, identifier } => cmd_cleanup(all, identifier),\n354\t        CliCommand::List { format } => cmd_list(format),\n355\t        CliCommand::Attach { identifier } => cmd_attach(&identifier),\n356\t        CliCommand::Status {\n357\t            format,\n358\t            by_worker,\n359\t            cost,\n360\t            since,\n361\t            until,\n362\t            idle_strands,\n363\t        } => cmd_status(format, by_worker, cost, since, until, idle_strands),\n364\t        CliCommand::Logs {\n365\t            follow,\n366\t            filter,\n367\t            since,\n368\t            until,\n369\t            format,\n370\t        } => cmd_logs(follow, filter, since, until, format),\n371\t        CliCommand::ConfigCmd {\n372\t            get,\n373\t            dump,\n374\t            show_source,\n375\t        } => cmd_config(get, dump, show_source),\n376\t        CliCommand::Doctor { repair, workspace } => cmd_doctor(repair, workspace),\n377\t        CliCommand::Init => cmd_init(),\n378\t        CliCommand::Version => {\n379\t            cmd_version();\n380\t            Ok(())\n381\t        }\n382\t        CliCommand::TestAgent { name } => cmd_test_agent(&name),\n383\t        CliCommand::Canary { status } => cmd_canary(status),\n384\t        CliCommand::Upgrade { check } => cmd_upgrade(check),\n385\t        CliCommand::Rollback => cmd_rollback(),\n386\t        CliCommand::Reflect { workspace, force } => cmd_reflect(workspace, force),\n387\t        CliCommand::UpdateRules { output } => cmd_update_rules(output),\n388\t        CliCommand::Stats {\n389\t            by,\n390\t            since,\n391\t            until,\n392\t            format,\n393\t        } => cmd_stats(by, since, until, format),\n394\t    }\n395\t}\n396\t\n397\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n398\t// Command handlers\n399\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n400\t\n401\t/// `needle run` — launch a worker.\n402\t///\n403\t/// Always creates dedicated tmux sessions for workers, even when invoked from\n404\t/// inside an existing tmux session. The only exception is a re-entrant inner\n405\t/// invocation launched by `launch_in_tmux()`, which is identified by the\n406\t/// `NEEDLE_INNER=1` environment variable and runs the worker directly.\n407\tfn cmd_run(\n408\t    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n409\t    agent: Option<String>,\n410\t    count: u32,\n411\t    identifier: Option<String>,\n412\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n413\t    resume: bool,\n414\t    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n415\t) -> Result<()> {\n416\t    // Determine workspace root (CLI arg → canonicalized, else global default).\n417\t    let workspace_root = if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n418\t        ws.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| ws.clone())\n419\t    } else {\n420\t        let global = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n421\t        global.workspace.default.clone()\n422\t    };\n423\t\n424\t    // Load full resolved config (global → workspace .needle.yaml → env → CLI).\n425\t    let cli_overrides = CliOverrides {\n426\t        workspace: Some(workspace_root.clone()),\n427\t        agent_binary: agent.clone(),\n428\t        max_workers: None,\n429\t        ..Default::default()\n430\t    };\n431\t    let (mut config, _) = ConfigLoader::load_resolved(&workspace_root, cli_overrides)?;\n432\t\n433\t    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n434\t        config.agent.timeout = t;\n435\t    }\n436\t\n437\t    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n438\t        config.self_modification.hot_reload = hr;\n439\t    }\n440\t\n441\t    if resume {\n442\t        // Hot-reload resume: inherit worker identity from --identifier,\n443\t        // load state from heartbeat file + registry, continue from SELECTING.\n444\t        let worker_id = identifier\n445\t            .clone()\n446\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n447\t\n448\t        // Load resume state from heartbeat and registry.\n449\t        let resume_state = crate::upgrade::ResumeState::load(&config, &worker_id)?;\n450\t\n451\t        // Emit upgrade.completed telemetry.\n452\t        let current_hash = crate::upgrade::file_hash(\n453\t            &std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?,\n454\t        )\n455\t        .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string());\n456\t\n457\t        match &resume_state {\n458\t            Some(state) => {\n459\t                tracing::info!(\n460\t                    worker = %worker_id,\n461\t                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n462\t                    beads_processed = state.beads_processed,\n463\t                    session = %state.session,\n464\t                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload\"\n465\t                );\n466\t            }\n467\t            None => {\n468\t                tracing::info!(\n469\t                    worker = %worker_id,\n470\t                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n471\t                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload (no prior state found)\"\n472\t                );\n473\t            }\n474\t        }\n475\t\n476\t        let tel = crate::telemetry::Telemetry::from_config(worker_id.clone(), &config.telemetry)\n477\t            .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n478\t                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"hook telemetry init failed, falling back\");\n479\t                crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(worker_id.clone())\n480\t            });\n481\t        tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::UpgradeCompleted {\n482\t            new_hash: current_hash,\n483\t        })?;\n484\t\n485\t        return run_worker(config, worker_id);\n486\t    }\n487\t\n488\t    if is_needle_inner() {\n489\t        // Re-entrant inner invocation launched by launch_in_tmux() — run\n490\t        // the worker directly inside the dedicated session already created.\n491\t        let worker_id = identifier\n492\t            .clone()\n493\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n494\t        let agent_name = agent.as_deref().unwrap_or(&config.agent.default);\n495\t        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n496\t        tracing::info!(worker = %worker_id, session = %session_name, \"starting worker (inner re-entrant invocation)\");\n497\t        run_worker(config, worker_id)\n498\t    } else {\n499\t        // Always create dedicated tmux sessions, even if already inside tmux.\n500\t        launch_workers(\n501\t            config, workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, hot_reload,\n502\t        )\n503\t    }\n504\t}\n505\t\n506\t/// Launch `count` workers in separate tmux sessions with staggered startup delays.\n507\tfn launch_workers(\n508\t    config: Config,\n509\t    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n510\t    agent: Option<String>,\n511\t    count: u32,\n512\t    identifier: Option<String>,\n513\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n514\t    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n515\t) -> Result<()> {\n516\t    let agent_name = agent\n517\t        .as_deref()\n518\t        .unwrap_or(&config.agent.default)\n519\t        .to_string();\n520\t    let stagger_secs = config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds;\n521\t    let max_workers = config.worker.max_workers;\n522\t\n523\t    if count == 0 {\n524\t        bail!(\"--count must be at least 1\");\n525\t    }\n526\t    if count as usize > NATO_ALPHABET.len() {\n527\t        bail!(\n528\t            \"--count {} exceeds the maximum of {} (NATO alphabet size)\",\n529\t            count,\n530\t            NATO_ALPHABET.len()\n531\t        );\n532\t    }\n533\t\n534\t    // Enforce max_workers cap (0 means unlimited).\n535\t    let effective_count = if max_workers > 0 && count > max_workers {\n536\t        tracing::warn!(\n537\t            requested = count,\n538\t            capped_to = max_workers,\n539\t            \"count exceeds max_workers; capping\"\n540\t        );\n541\t        eprintln!(\n542\t            \"Warning: --count {count} exceeds max_workers={max_workers}; launching {max_workers} workers\"\n543\t        );\n544\t        max_workers\n545\t    } else {\n546\t        count\n547\t    };\n548\t\n549\t    // --identifier is only meaningful for a single worker.\n550\t    if effective_count > 1 && identifier.is_some() {\n551\t        bail!(\"--identifier cannot be combined with --count > 1; identifiers are auto-assigned from the NATO alphabet\");\n552\t    }\n553\t\n554\t    // Detect existing sessions to avoid name collisions.\n555\t    let occupied = occupied_worker_ids(&agent_name)?;\n556\t    if !occupied.is_empty() {\n557\t        tracing::info!(\n558\t            occupied = ?occupied,\n559\t            \"found existing worker sessions\"\n560\t        );\n561\t    }\n562\t\n563\t    // Reject --identifier collision early.\n564\t    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n565\t        if occupied.contains(id) {\n566\t            bail!(\n567\t                \"worker '{}' is already running in session 'needle-{}-{}'\",\n568\t                id,\n569\t                agent_name,\n570\t                id\n571\t            );\n572\t        }\n573\t    }\n574\t\n575\t    // Build the list of worker IDs, skipping occupied names.\n576\t    let worker_ids: Vec<String> = if effective_count == 1 {\n577\t        vec![identifier.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n578\t            // Pick the first available NATO name.\n579\t            NATO_ALPHABET\n580\t                .iter()\n581\t                .find(|name| !occupied.contains(**name))\n582\t                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n583\t                .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string())\n584\t        })]\n585\t    } else {\n586\t        let mut ids = Vec::with_capacity(effective_count as usize);\n587\t        for name in NATO_ALPHABET {\n588\t            if ids.len() >= effective_count as usize {\n589\t                break;\n590\t            }\n591\t            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n592\t                tracing::warn!(\n593\t                    worker_id = %name,\n594\t                    \"skipping occupied worker name\"\n595\t                );\n596\t                continue;\n597\t            }\n598\t            ids.push(name.to_string());\n599\t        }\n600\t        if ids.len() < effective_count as usize {\n601\t            bail!(\n602\t                \"cannot launch {} workers — only {} NATO names available ({} occupied)\",\n603\t                effective_count,\n604\t                ids.len(),\n605\t                occupied.len()\n606\t            );\n607\t        }\n608\t        ids\n609\t    };\n610\t\n611\t    for (seq, worker_id) in worker_ids.iter().enumerate() {\n612\t        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n613\t\n614\t        tracing::info!(\n615\t            worker_id = %worker_id,\n616\t            sequence = seq,\n617\t            total = effective_count,\n618\t            session = %session_name,\n619\t            \"launching worker\"\n620\t        );\n621\t\n622\t        // Stagger: sleep before launching subsequent workers.\n623\t        if seq > 0 && stagger_secs > 0 {\n624\t            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(stagger_secs));\n625\t        }\n626\t\n627\t        launch_in_tmux(\n628\t            &session_name,\n629\t            workspace.clone(),\n630\t            agent.clone(),\n631\t            Some(worker_id.clone()),\n632\t            timeout,\n633\t            hot_reload,\n634\t        )?;\n635\t\n636\t        println!(\n637\t            \"[{}/{}] Started worker '{}' in tmux session: {session_name}\",\n638\t            seq + 1,\n639\t            effective_count,\n640\t            worker_id\n641\t        );\n642\t    }\n643\t\n644\t    let sanitized_agent = sanitize_session_name(&agent_name);\n645\t    if effective_count > 1 {\n646\t        println!(\n647\t            \"\\nStarted {effective_count} workers (stagger: {stagger_secs}s between launches).\"\n648\t        );\n649\t        println!(\"Attach to a worker with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-<name>\");\n650\t    } else {\n651\t        let worker_id = &worker_ids[0];\n652\t        println!(\"Attach with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-{worker_id}\");\n653\t    }\n654\t\n655\t    Ok(())\n656\t}\n657\t\n658\t/// Initialize the tracing subscriber with OTLP layer if configured.\n659\t///\n660\t/// This must be called before any tracing spans are created so that the OTLP\n661\t/// layer can export them to the configured collector.\n662\t///\n663\t/// Note: Shutdown is handled by the OtlpSink in the telemetry module, not here.\n664\t#[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\n665\tfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n666\t    worker_id: String,\n667\t    session_id: String,\n668\t    config: &crate::config::Config,\n669\t) -> Result<()> {\n670\t    use opentelemetry::trace::TracerProvider;\n671\t    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n672\t\n673\t    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n674\t\n675\t    // Check if OTLP is enabled\n676\t    if !config.telemetry.otlp_sink.enabled {\n677\t        // No OTLP - just initialize with fmt layer\n678\t        let fmt_layer = tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n679\t            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n680\t            .with_ansi(use_ansi);\n681\t        tracing_subscriber::registry()\n682\t            .with(fmt_layer)\n683\t            .try_init()\n684\t            .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n685\t        return Ok(());\n686\t    }\n687\t\n688\t    // OTLP is enabled - ws.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| ws.clone())\n    } else {\n        let global = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n        global.workspace.default.clone()\n    };\n\n    // Load full resolved config .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string());\n\n        match &resume_state {\n            Some(state) => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    worker = %worker_id,\n binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload (no prior state found)\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        let tel = crate::telemetry::Telemetry::from_config(worker_id.clone(), &config.telemetry)\n            .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"hook telemetry init failed, falling back\");\n                crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(worker_id.clone())\n            });\n        tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::UpgradeCompleted {\n            new_hash: current_hash,\n        })?;\n\n        return run_worker(config, worker_id);\n    }\n\n    if is_needle_inner() {\n        // Re-entrant inner invocation launched by launch_in_tmux() — run\n        // the worker directly inside the dedicated session already created.\n        let worker_id = identifier\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n        let agent_name = agent.as_deref().unwrap_or(&config.agent.default);\n        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n        tracing::info!(worker = %worker_id, session = %session_name, \"starting worker (inner re-entrant invocation)\");\n        run_worker(config, worker_id)\n    } else {\n        // Always create dedicated tmux sessions, even if already inside tmux.\n        launch_workers(\n            config, workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, hot_reload,\n        )\n    }\n}\n\n/// Launch `count` workers in separate tmux sessions with staggered startup delays.\nfn launch_workers(\n    config: Config,\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    count: u32,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let agent_name = agent\n        .as_deref()\n        .unwrap_or(&config.agent.default)\n        .to_string();\n    let stagger_secs = config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds;\n    let max_workers = config.worker.max_workers;\n\n    if count == 0 {\n        bail!(\"--count must be at least 1\");\n    }\n    if count as usize > NATO_ALPHABET.len() {\n        bail!(\n            \"--count {} exceeds the maximum of {} (NATO alphabet size)\",\n            count,\n            NATO_ALPHABET.len()\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Enforce max_workers cap (0 means unlimited).\n    let effective_count = if max_workers > 0 && count > max_workers {\n        tracing::warn!(\n            requested = count,\n            capped_to = max_workers,\n            \"count exceeds max_workers; capping\"\n        );\n        eprintln!(\n            \"Warning: --count {count} exceeds max_workers={max_workers}; launching {max_workers} workers\"\n        );\n        max_workers\n    } else {\n        count\n    };\n\n    // --identifier is only meaningful for a single worker.\n    if effective_count > 1 && identifier.is_some() {\n        bail!(\"--identifier cannot be combined with --count > 1; identifiers are auto-assigned from the NATO alphabet\");\n    }\n\n    // Detect existing sessions to avoid name collisions.\n    let occupied = occupied_worker_ids(&agent_name)?;\n    if !occupied.is_empty() {\n        tracing::info!(\n            occupied = ?occupied,\n            \"found existing worker sessions\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Reject --identifier collision early.\n    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n        if occupied.contains(id) {\n            bail!(\n                \"worker '{}' is already running in session 'needle-{}-{}'\",\n                id,\n                agent_name,\n                id\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Build the list of worker IDs, skipping occupied names.\n    let worker_ids: Vec<String> = if effective_count == 1 {\n        vec![identifier.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n            // Pick the first available NATO name.\n            NATO_ALPHABET\n                .iter()\n                .find(|name| !occupied.contains(**name))\n                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string())\n        })]\n    } else {\n        let mut ids = Vec::with_capacity(effective_count as usize);\n        for name in NATO_ALPHABET {\n            if ids.len() >= effective_count as usize {\n                break;\n            }\n            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    worker_id = %name,\n                    \"skipping occupied worker name\"\n                );\n                continue;\n            }\n            ids.push(name.to_string());\n        }\n        if ids.len() < effective_count as usize {\n            bail!(\n                \"cannot launch {} workers — only {} NATO names available ({} occupied)\",\n                effective_count,\n                ids.len(),\n                occupied.len()\n            );\n        }\n        ids\n    };\n\n    for (seq, worker_id) in worker_ids.iter().enumerate() {\n        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            worker_id = %worker_id,\n            sequence = seq,\n            total = effective_count,\n            session = %session_name,\n            \"launching worker\"\n        );\n\n        // Stagger: sleep before launching subsequent workers.\n        if seq > 0 && stagger_secs > 0 {\n            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(stagger_secs));\n        }\n\n        launch_in_tmux(\n            &session_name,\n            workspace.clone(),\n            agent.clone(),\n            Some(worker_id.clone()),\n            timeout,\n            hot_reload,\n        )?;\n\n        println!(\n            \"[{}/{}] Started worker '{}' in tmux session: {session_name}\",\n            seq + 1,\n            effective_count,\n            worker_id\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sanitized_agent = sanitize_session_name(&agent_name);\n    if effective_count > 1 {\n        println!(\n            \"\\nStarted {effective_count} workers (stagger: {stagger_secs}s between launches).\"\n        );\n        println!(\"Attach to a worker with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-<name>\");\n    } else {\n        let worker_id = &worker_ids[0];\n        println!(\"Attach with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-{worker_id}\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Initialize the tracing subscriber with OTLP layer if configured.\n///\n/// This must be called before any tracing spans are created so that the OTLP\n/// layer can export them to the configured collector.\n///\n/// Note: Shutdown is handled by the OtlpSink in the telemetry module, not here.\n#[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\nfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n    worker_id: String,\n    session_id: String,\n    config: &crate::config::Config,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use opentelemetry::trace::TracerProvider;\n    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n\n    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n\n    // Check if OTLP is enabled\n    if !config.telemetry.otlp_sink.enabled {\n        // No OTLP - just initialize with fmt layer\n        let fmt_layer = tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n            .with_ansi(use_ansi);\n        tracing_subscriber::registry()\n            .with(fmt_layer)\n            .try_init()\n            .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // OTLP is enabled - create the OTLP layer inline\n    // We create it inline to avoid type erasure issues with boxed layers\n    let otlp_config = &config.telemetry.otlp_sink;\n\n    // Build resource attributes\n    let resource = crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_resource(\n        &worker_id,\n        &session_id,\n        otlp_config,\n        Some(&config.agent.default),\n        None, // model - not available in AgentConfig\n        config.workspace.default.to_str(),\n    )\n    .context(\"failed to build OTel resource\")?;\n\n    // Create drop channel for tracing layer\n    let (drop_tx, mut drop_rx) =\n        tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel::<crate::telemetry::otlp::DropEvent>();\n    tokio::spawn(async move {\n        while let Some(drop) = drop_rx.recv().await {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                signal = drop.signal.as_str(),\n                dropped_count = drop.dropped_count,\n                \"OTLP tracing layer export failure\"\n            );\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Build exporters and tracer provider based on protocol\n    let (tracer_provider, ..) = match otlp_config.protocol.as_str() {\n        \"grpc\" => {\n            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_grpc_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n        }\n        \"http\" | \"http/protobuf\" => {\n            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_http_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n        }\n        other => anyhow::bail!(\"invalid OTLP protocol: {other}, must be 'grpc' or 'http'\"),\n    };\n\n    // Create the OpenTelemetry tracing layer\n    let otlp_layer = tracing_opentelemetry::layer().with_tracer(tracer_provider.tracer(\"needle\"));\n\n    // Create a fmt layer that works with any subscriber implementing LookupSpan\n    // We build this after the OTLP layer to ensure proper type compatibility\n    let subscriber = tracing_subscriber::registry().with(otlp_layer).with(\n        tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n            .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n    );\n\n    subscriber\n        .try_init()\n        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber with OTLP\")?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// No-op tracing initialization when OTLP feature is disabled.\n#[cfg(not(feature = \"otlp\"))]\nfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n    _worker_id: String,\n    _session_id: String,\n    _config: &crate::config::Config,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n\n    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n\n    // Initialize with just the stdout layer when OTLP is disabled\n    tracing_subscriber::registry()\n        .with(\n            tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n                .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n                .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n        )\n        .try_init()\n        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Helper function to determine ANSI support (non-Android platforms).\n#[cfg(not(target_os = \"android\"))]\nfn use_ansi() -> bool {\n    atty::is(atty::Stream::Stderr)\n}\n\n/// Helper function for Android (no ANSI).\n#[cfg(target_os = \"android\")]\nfn use_ansi() -> bool {\n    false\n}\n\n/// Generate a session ID for a worker.\n///\n/// Uses the telemetry module's session ID generator.\nfn generate_session_id_for_worker() -> String {\n    crate::telemetry::generate_session_id()\n}\n\n/// Start the worker state machine (called when inside tmux or for direct mode).\n///\n/// Creates telemetry and the tokio runtime *before* any other initialization\n/// so that `worker.booting` is the very first JSONL event. Each subsequent\n/// init step is wrapped with `init.step.started` / `init.step.completed` so a\n/// silent hang pinpoints the exact blocking call.\nfn run_worker(config: Config, worker_name: String) -> Result<()> {\n    let boot_start = Instant::now();\n    let qualified_id = format!(\"{}-{}\", config.agent.default, worker_name);\n\n    // Phase 0: create tokio runtime + telemetry, emit worker.booting immediately.\n    // Emit eprintln diagnostics before each step so hangs are visible even if telemetry fails.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating tokio runtime...\");\n    let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().context(\"failed to create tokio runtime\")?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tokio runtime created\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: initializing tracing subscriber...\");\n    let session_id = generate_session_id_for_worker();\n    init_tracing_subscriber(qualified_id.clone(), session_id.clone(), &config)?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tracing subscriber initialized\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating telemetry...\");\n    let telemetry =\n        Telemetry::from_config(qualified_id.clone(), &config.telemetry).unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to create hook-enabled telemetry, falling back\");\n            Telemetry::new(qualified_id.clone())\n        });\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: telemetry created\");\n\n    // Emit worker.booting SYNCHRONOUSLY before starting the async writer.\n    // This guarantees the event is written to disk even if start_and_wait() hangs.\n    // Fixes the silent pre-init deadlock where the JSONL file is created but empty.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: emitting worker.booting event (sync)...\");\n    telemetry.emit_sync(EventKind::WorkerBooting {\n        worker_name: worker_name.clone(),\n        version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string(),\n    })?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: worker.booting written to disk\");\n\n    // Start the async writer thread after worker.booting is on disk.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting telemetry writer thread...\");\n    rt.block_on(telemetry.start_and_wait())\n        .context(\"writer thread failed to start\")?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: writer thread started\");\n\n    // Phase 1: bead store discovery.\n    // Use BfCliBeadStore for atomic server-selected bead claiming.\n    let store: Arc<dyn crate::bead_store::BeadStore> =\n        Arc::new(init_step(\"bead_store_discover\", &telemetry, || {\n            crate::bead_store::BfCliBeadStore::discover(\n                config.workspace.default.clone(),\n                None,                       // model: do not filter by model — beads are untagged\n                Some(\"needle\".to_string()), // harness\n                Some(env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string()), // harness_version\n            )\n            .context(\"failed to locate bf CLI for bead store\")\n        })?);\n\n    // Phase 2: worker construction (heavy — prompt loading, adapter discovery, etc.).\n    let mut worker = init_step(\"worker_construction\", &telemetry, || {\n        Ok(Worker::new_with_telemetry(\n            config,\n            worker_name.clone(),\n            store,\n            telemetry.clone(),\n        ))\n    })?;\n\n    // Boot timeout guard: self-abort if init took >60 s.\n    let elapsed_ms = boot_start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n    if elapsed_ms > 60_000 {\n        telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerBootTimeout { elapsed_ms })?;\n        bail!(\"boot exceeded 60 s ({elapsed_ms} ms), aborting\");\n    }\n\n    eprintln!(\n        \"NEEDLE worker boot: all init steps completed in {elapsed_ms}ms, starting worker loop...\"\n    );\n    let result = rt.block_on(worker.run())?;\n\n    tracing::info!(final_state = %result, \"worker finished\");\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Emit start/complete telemetry around a fallible initialization step.\n///\n/// Each step's completion is force-flushed to disk so that if a subsequent\n/// step blocks indefinitely, the telemetry log shows exactly where it stopped.\n/// Also emits eprintln diagnostics for visibility even if telemetry hangs.\nfn init_step<T, F>(name: &str, tel: &Telemetry, f: F) -> Result<T>\nwhere\n    F: FnOnce() -> Result<T>,\n{\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting init step '{name}'...\");\n    tel.emit(EventKind::InitStepStarted {\n        step: name.to_string(),\n    })?;\n    let t = Instant::now();\n    let result = f();\n    let elapsed = t.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n    tel.emit(EventKind::InitStepCompleted {\n        step: name.to_string(),\n        duration_ms: elapsed,\n    })?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: init step '{name}' completed in {elapsed}ms\");\n    // Force-flush so the step completion is visible before the next (potentially blocking) step.\n    tel.force_flush(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1))?;\n    result\n}\n\n/// Returns true when this process is a re-entrant inner invocation launched\n/// by `launch_in_tmux()`, indicated by `NEEDLE_INNER=1` in the environment.\nfn is_needle_inner() -> bool {\n    std::env::var(\"NEEDLE_INNER\").is_ok_and(|v| v == \"1\")\n}\n\n/// Create a single tmux session and re-exec self inside it with `--count 1`.\nfn launch_in_tmux(\n    session_name: &str,\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Build the command that tmux will run inside the session.\n    let self_exe = std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?;\n    let mut inner_args = vec![\"run\".to_string()];\n\n    if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n        inner_args.push(\"--workspace\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(ws.display().to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(ref a) = agent {\n        inner_args.push(\"--agent\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(a.clone());\n    }\n    // Each session runs exactly one worker; identifier is always resolved before call.\n    inner_args.push(\"--count\".to_string());\n    inner_args.push(\"1\".to_string());\n    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n        inner_args.push(\"--identifier\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(id.clone());\n    }\n    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n        inner_args.push(\"--timeout\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(t.to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n        inner_args.push(\"--hot-reload\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(hr.to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Build stderr log path: ~/.needle/logs/<session_name>.stderr.log\n    let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").unwrap_or_else(|_| \".\".to_string());\n    let stderr_log = format!(\"{home}/.needle/logs/{session_name}.stderr.log\");\n\n    let inner_cmd = format!(\n        \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 {} {} 2>> {}\",\n        shell_escape(&self_exe.display().to_string()),\n        inner_args\n            .iter()\n            .map(|a| shell_escape(a))\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\" \"),\n        shell_escape(&stderr_log)\n    );\n\n    let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n        .args([\"new-session\", \"-d\", \"-s\", session_name, &inner_cmd])\n        .status()\n        .context(\"failed to launch tmux — is tmux installed?\")?;\n\n    if !status.success() {\n        bail!(\n            \"tmux new-session exited with status {} for session '{}'\",\n            status,\n            session_name\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle stop` — send SIGTERM to worker processes in tmux sessions.\nfn cmd_stop(all: bool, identifier: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    if !all && identifier.is_none() {\n        bail!(\"specify --all or --identifier <NAME>\");\n    }\n\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No needle sessions running.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let targets: Vec<&str> = if all {\n        sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect()\n    } else {\n        let id = identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        sessions\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.name.contains(id))\n            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    if targets.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching sessions found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    for session in &targets {\n        tracing::info!(session = %session, \"sending SIGTERM to tmux session\");\n        // tmux send-keys sends C-c to the foreground process\n        let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n            .args([\"send-keys\", \"-t\", session, \"C-c\", \"\"])\n            .status()\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to send SIGTERM to session '{session}'\"))?;\n\n        if status.success() {\n            // Wait up to 5 seconds for the worker to exit gracefully\n            for _ in 0..50 {\n                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));\n                let session_exists = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n                    .args([\"has-session\", \"-t\", session])\n                    .output()\n                    .map(|o| o.status.success())\n                    .unwrap_or(false);\n                if !session_exists {\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            // Kill the session to clean up (worker may have already exited)\n            let kill_status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n                .args([\"kill-session\", \"-t\", session])\n                .status();\n            match kill_status {\n                Ok(s) if s.success() => println!(\"Stopped: {session}\"),\n                Ok(_) => println!(\"Stopped: {session} (session already gone)\"),\n                Err(e) => println!(\"Warning: stopped {session} but failed to kill session: {e}\"),\n            }\n        } else {\n            println!(\"Warning: could not stop session '{session}' (status: {status})\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle cleanup` — remove orphaned tmux sessions.\n///\n/// Finds and removes needle tmux sessions that no longer have active workers.\n/// With --all, removes all needle sessions regardless of worker status.\nfn cmd_cleanup(all: bool, identifier: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No needle sessions running.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let targets: Vec<&str> = if all {\n        sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect()\n    } else {\n        let id = identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        sessions\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| id.is_empty() || s.name.contains(id))\n            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    if targets.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching sessions found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let mut cleaned = 0;\n    for session in &targets {\n        // Kill the session\n        let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n            .args([\"kill-session\", \"-t\", session])\n            .status();\n\n        match status {\n            Ok(s) if s.success() => {\n                println!(\"Cleaned up: {session}\");\n                cleaned += 1;\n            }\n            Ok(_) => {\n                println!(\"Warning: session '{session}' already gone\");\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                println!(\"Warning: failed to cleanup session '{session}': {e}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if cleaned == 0 {\n        println!(\"No sessions cleaned up.\");\n    } else {\n        println!(\"Cleaned up {cleaned} session(s).\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle list` — show running needle sessions.\nfn cmd_list(format: ListFormat) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        match format {\n            ListFormat::Table => println!(\"No needle sessions running.\"),\n            ListFormat::Json => println!(\"[]\"),\n        }\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    match format {\n        ListFormat::Table => {\n            println!(\"{:<40} {:<20} {:<10}\", \"SESSION\", \"CREATED\", \"STATUS\");\n            println!(\"{}\", \"-\".repeat(70));\n            for s in &sessions {\n                println!(\"{:<40} {:<20} {:<10}\", s.name, s.created, s.status);\n            }\n        }\n        ListFormat::Json => {\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&sessions)\n                .context(\"failed to serialize sessions to JSON\")?;\n            println!(\"{json}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle init` — initialize v2 config with optional v1 migration.\n///\n/// Creates ~/.config/needle/config.yaml. Detects existing v1 artifacts\n/// in ~/.needle/ and migrates compatible settings (agent name, workspace\n/// path, worker count) to the v2 YAML schema. Safe to run on already-\n/// initialized installs (idempotent).\nfn cmd_init() -> Result<()> {\n    /// Resolve a path relative to the user's home directory.\n    fn dirs_or_home(relative: &str) -> PathBuf {\n        if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os(\"HOME\") {\n            PathBuf::from(home).join(relative)\n        } else {\n            PathBuf::from(\"/tmp\").join(relative)\n        }\n    }\n\n    let config_path = dirs_or_home(\".config/needle/config.yaml\");\n    let v1_dir = dirs_or_home(\".needle\");\n\n    // Check if v2 config already exists.\n    if config_path.exists() {\n        println!(\"Config already exists: {}\", config_path.display());\n        let config = ConfigLoader::load_from_path(&config_path)?;\n        println!(\"  Agent default: {}\", config.agent.default);\n        println!(\"  Workspace: {}\", config.workspace.default.display());\n        println!(\"  Max workers: {}\", config.worker.max_workers);\n        println!(\"\\nTo reinitialize, delete the existing config file first.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Detect v1 artifacts and migrate compatible settings.\n    let mut agent_name = None::<String>;\n    let mut workspace_path = None::<PathBuf>;\n\n    // Check for v1 directory.\n    if v1_dir.exists() && v1_dir.is_dir() {\n        println!(\"Detected v1 artifacts: {}\", v1_dir.display());\n\n        // Look for v1 config hints (file-based heuristics).\n        // v1 stored agent name as a subdirectory: ~/.needle/<agent>/\n        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&v1_dir) {\n            for entry in entries.flatten() {\n                let path = entry.path();\n                if path.is_dir() {\n                    let name = path.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str());\n ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `needle attach <identifier>` — attach to a running worker's tmux session.\nfn cmd_attach(identifier: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        bail!(\"no needle sessions running\");\n    }\n\n    // Find matching session: exact match on identifier portion or substring match on full name.\n    let matches: Vec<&TmuxSession> = sessions\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|s| s.name.ends_with(&format!(\"-{identifier}\")) || s.name.contains(identifier))\n        .collect();\n\n    if matches.is_empty() {\n        let available: Vec<&str> = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect();\n        bail!(\n            \"no session matching '{}'; available: {}\",\n            identifier,\n            available.join(\", \")\n        );\n    }\n\n    if matches.len() > 1 {\n        let names: Vec<&str> = matches.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect();\n        bail!(\n            \"ambiguous identifier '{}'; matches: {}\",\n            identifier,\n            names.join(\", \")\n        );\n    }\n\n    let session = &matches[0].name;\n    let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n        .args([\"attach-session\", \"-t\", session])\n        .status()\n        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to attach to tmux session '{session}'\"))?;\n\n    if !status.success() {\n        bail!(\"tmux attach-session exited with status {status} for '{session}'\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle status` — show fleet status summary.\nfn cmd_status(\n    format: ListFormat,\n    by_worker: bool,\n    cost: bool,\n    since: Option<String>,\n    until: Option<String>,\n    idle_strands: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n    let needle_home = config.workspace.home.clone();\n    let registry =             .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<HeartbeatData>(&s).ok())\n            } else {\n                None\n            };\n\n            let is_alive = is_pid_alive(w.pid);\n   let events = telemetry::read_logs(&log_dir, since_dt, until_dt, None)?;\n        let cs = telemetry::compute_cost_summary(&events);\n        let by_worker_costs = telemetry::compute_cost_by_worker(&events);\n        let by_workspace_costs = telemetry::compute_cost_by_workspace(&events);\n\n        match format {\n            ListFormat::Table => {\n stats` — show outcome statistics from telemetry logs.\nfn cmd_stats(\n    by: StatsBy,\n    since: Option<String>,\n    until: Option<String>,\n    format: ListFormat,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use crate::stats::{compute_stats, StatsDimension};\n\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n    let log_dir = config.workspace.home.join(\"logs\");\n\n    let since_dt = since.as_deref().map(telemetry::parse_since).transpose()?;\n    let until_dt = until.as_deref().map(telemetry::parse_until).transpose()?;\n    let events = telemetry::read_logs(&log_dir, since_dt, &std::sync::Mutex<std::io::BufWriter<std::fs::File>>,\n        path: &Path,\n        worker_id: &str,\n        session_id: &str,\n        version: &str,\n        timeout: std::time::Duration,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        use std::io::Write;\n        use std::sync::mpsc;\n        use std::thread;\n\n        let event = TelemetryEvent {\n            timestamp: Utc::now(),\n       workspace: None,\n            duration_ms: None,\n            data: serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_id, \"version\": version }),\n            trace_id: None,\n            span_id: None,\n        };\n        let line = serde_json::to_string(&event)?;\n        let path_for_error = path.display().to_string();\n        let path_clone = path.to_path_buf();\n\n        // JoinHandle::join() has no timeout in Rust's std — use a channel with recv_timeout.\n        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel::<Result<(), String>>();\n\n        // The JoinHandle is intentionally dropped on timeout: dropping detaches the thread,\n        // which continues running until it completes or the process exits.\n        let _handle = thread::spawn(move || {\n            let result: Result<(), String> = (|| {\n                let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n                    .create(true)\n                    .append(true)\n                    .open(&path_clone)\n                    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                let mut writer = std::io::BufWriter::new(file);\n                writeln!(writer, \"{line}\").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                writer.flush().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                writer.get_ref().sync_all().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                Ok(())\n            })();\n            // Ignore send error: receiver may have timed out and been dropped.\n            let _ = tx.send(result);\n        });\n\n        match rx.recv_timeout(timeout) {\n            Ok(Ok(())) => Ok(()),\n            Ok(Err(e)) => Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n                \"failed to write boot event to {}: {}\",\n                path_for_error,\n                e\n            )),\n            Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Timeout) => Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n                \"timed out writing boot event to {} after {:?} (filesystem may be hung)\",\n                path_for_error,\n                timeout\n            )),\n            Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Disconnected) => Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n                \"boot event writer thread disconnected for {}\",\n                path_for_error\n            )),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Sink for FileSink {\n    fn accept(&self, event: &TelemetryEvent) -> Result<()> {\n        use std::io::Write;\n        let line = serde_json::to_string(event)?;\n        let mut writer = self\n            .writer\n            .lock()\n            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(\"lock poisoned: {}\", e))?;\n        writeln!(writer, \"{line}\")?;\n        writer.flush()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn flush(&self, _deadline: std::time::Duration) -> Result<()> {\n        use std::io::Write;\n        let mut writer = self\n            .writer\n            .lock()\n            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(\"lock poisoned: {}\", e))?;\n        writer.flush()?;\n        // fsync to ensure durability before shutdown\n        writer.get_ref().sync_all()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── StdoutSink ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Human-readable, color-coded telemetry sink for {\n        format!(\"{:.1}s\", ms as f64 / 1000.0)\n    } else {\n        let mins = ms / 60_000;\n        let secs = (ms % 60_000) / 1000;\n        format!(\"{mins}m{secs}s\")\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Session ID generation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Generate an 8-hex-char session ID.\n///\n/// Uses `/dev/urandom` when available, falls back to PID XOR timestamp.\npub fn generate_session_id() -> String {\n    // Try /dev/urandom (Linux/macOS)\n    if let Ok(mut f) = std::fs::File::open(\"/dev/urandom\") {\n        use std::io::Read;\n        let mut buf = [0u8; 4];\n        if f.read_exact(&mut buf).is_ok() {\n            return format!(\"{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}\", buf[0], buf[1], buf[2], buf[3]);\n        }\n    }\n    // Fallback: PID XOR nanosecond timestamp\n    let pid = std::process::id();\n    let ts = Utc::now().timestamp_millis() as u64;\n    let hash = pid as u64 ^ ts;\n    format!(\"{:08x}\", hash & 0xffff_ffff)\n}\n\n// ─── Trace target(s).\nstruct CompiledHook {\n    filter: regex::Regex,\n    /// Shell command (empty = disabled).\n    command: String,\n    /// Webhook URL (None = disabled).\n    url: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// Dispatches matching telemetry events to external commands and/or URLs.\n///\n/// Each hook has a glob pattern matched against `event_type`. When an event\n/// matches, the event JSON is piped to `command`'s stdin and/or HTTP-POSTed\n/// to `url`. Execution is fire-and-forget — failed hooks emit `SinkError`\n/// events to the file sink but never block the worker or recurse into hooks.\npub struct HookSink {\n    hooks: Vec<CompiledHook>,\n}\n\nimpl HookSink {\n    /// Compile hook configs into a `HookSink`.\n    ///\n    /// Returns an error if any `event_filter` is an invalid glob pattern.\n    pub fn new(configs: &[crate::config::HookConfig]) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut hooks = Vec::with_capacity(configs.len());\n        for cfg in configs {\n            let filter = glob_to_regex(&cfg.event_filter)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid hook filter: {}\", cfg.event_filter))?;\n            hooks.push(CompiledHook {\n                filter,\n                command: cfg.command.clone(),\n                url: cfg.url.clone(),\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(HookSink { hooks })\n    }\n\n    /// Check whether any hooks are configured.\n    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {\n        self.hooks.is_empty()\n    }\n\n    /// Dispatch an event to all matching hooks (fire-and-forget).\n    ///\n    /// Returns a list of `SinkError` events for hooks that failed, so the\n    /// caller can write them to the file sink without recursion.\n    pub fn dispatch(&self, event: &TelemetryEvent) -> Vec<TelemetryEvent> {\n        // Never dispatch SinkError events to hooks — prevents recursion.\n        if event.event_type == \"telemetry.sink_error\" {\n            return Vec::new();\n        }\n\n        let json = match serde_json::to_string(event) {\n            Ok(j) => j,\n            Err(_) => return Vec::new(),\n        };\n\n        let mut failures = Vec::new();\n        for hook in &self.hooks {\n            if !hook.filter.is_match(&event.event_type) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Dispatch to command if configured.\n            if !hook.command.is_empty() {\n                match Self::run_hook(&hook.command, &json) {\n                    Ok(()) => {}\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        failures.push(TelemetryEvent {\n                            timestamp: Utc::now(),\n                            event_type: \"telemetry.sink_error\".to_string(),\n                            worker_id: event.worker_id.clone(),\n                            session_id: event.session_id.clone(),\n                            sequence: 0, // sequence is set by the emitter, not here\n                            bead_id: None,\n                            workspace: None,\n                            data: serde_json::json!({\n                                \"hook_command\": hook.command,\n                                \"event_filter\": hook.filter.as_str(),\n                                \"original_event_type\": event.event_type,\n                                \"error\": e.to_string(),\n                            }),\n                            duration_ms: None,\n                            trace_id: None,\n                            span_id: None,\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Dispatch to URL if configured.\n            if let Some(ref url) = hook.url {\n                match Self::post_url(url, &json) {\n                    Ok(()) => {}\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        failures.push(TelemetryEvent {\n                            timestamp: Utc::now(),\n                            event_type: \"telemetry.sink_error\".to_string(),\n                            worker_id: event.worker_id.clone(),\n                            session_id: event.session_id.clone(),\n                            sequence: 0,\n                            bead_id: None,\n                            workspace: None,\n                            data: serde_json::json!({\n                                \"hook_url\": url,\n                                \"event_filter\": hook.filter.as_str(),\n                                \"original_event_type\": event.event_type,\n                                \"error\": e.to_string(),\n                            }),\n                            duration_ms: None,\n                            trace_id: None,\n                            span_id: None,\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        failures\n    }\n\n    /// Execute a single hook command, piping JSON to its stdin.\n    ///\n    /// Spawns `sh -c <command>` with the event JSON on stdin, waits for\n    /// completion, and returns an error if the command exits non-zero.\n    /// This runs inside the background writer task so blocking is acceptable.\n    fn run_hook(command: &str, json: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        use std::io::Write;\n        use std::process::{Command, Stdio};\n\n        let mut child = Command::new(\"sh\")\n            .arg(\"-c\")\n            .arg(command)\n            .stdin(Stdio::piped())\n            .stdout(Stdio::null())\n            .stderr(Stdio::null())\n            .spawn()\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to spawn hook: {command}\"))?;\n\n        if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {\n            // Best-effort write; ignore broken pipe if child exits early.\n            let _ = stdin.write_all(json.as_bytes());\n        }\n\n        // Wait for the child and check exit status.\n        let status = child\n            .wait()\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to wait for hook: {command}\"))?;\n\n        if !status.success() {\n            anyhow::bail!(\n                \"hook exited with status {}: {command}\",\n                status.code().unwrap_or(-1)\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// HTTP POST the event JSON to a webhook URL.\n    ///\n    /// Sets `Content-Type: application/json` and applies a 10-second timeout.\n    /// Returns an error if the request fails or the This runs inside the background writer task so blocking is\n    /// acceptable.\n    fn post_url(url: &str, json: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        ureq::post(url)\n            .set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n            .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10))\n            .send_string(json)\n            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(\"webhook POST to {url} failed: {e}\"))?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Sink for HookSink {\n    fn accept(&self, event: &TelemetryEvent) -> Result<()> {\n        let failures = self.dispatch(event);\n        for fail in &failures {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                hook_error = %fail.data,\n                original_event = %event.event_type,\n                \"telemetry hook dispatch failed\"\n            );\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn flush(&self, _deadline: std::time::Duration) -> Result<()> {\n        // hooks run synchronously in accept(); nothing to drain\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Telemetry emitter ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Non-blocking telemetry emitter.\n///\n/// Cloning a `Telemetry` handle is cheap — it shares the same background\n/// writer and sequence counter.\n///\n/// The writer task must be started by calling `start()` from within a tokio\n/// runtime context. otlp_shutdown: Arc<std::sync::Mutex<Option<OtlpShutdown>>>,\n}\n\n/// Internal message type for the writer task.\n#[allow(clippy::large_enum_variant)]\nenum WriterMessage {\n
